summary: Mobile Wallet Card Tap Bug Fix VERIFIED - All 6 wallet buttons/cards tested successfully on iPhone-like viewport (390x844). The bug where cards 'Kasse/Händler', 'Privat empfangen', and 'Privat senden' were visible but not clickable/tappable on mobile/iPhone has been FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: WalletPage.jsx lines 593-605: Lower wallet cards now use native <button> instead of motion.button - correct fix for iOS tap issues
WalletPage.jsx line 38: tapSafeButtonStyle with touchAction:'manipulation' and WebkitTapHighlightColor:'transparent' - proper iOS tap optimization
WalletPage.jsx line 598: Cards have z-index:10 via inline style - prevents overlay interception
WalletPage.jsx line 597: handleWalletRouteNavigate handler properly routes clicks to onNavigate
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile wallet card tap bug has been fixed.
